claim: Alice saw Bob with a telescope.
interpretations: Alice used a telescope to see Bob.
Alice saw Bob, who had a telescope.

examples.title: Two alternative logical forms
examples.program:
0.6::reading(p0); 0.4::reading(p1).
0.9::observation(o0,supported); 0.1::observation(o0,refuted).
0.1::observation(o1,supported); 0.9::observation(o1,refuted).
uses(p0,o0).
uses(p1,o1).
uses(_,_) :- fail.
observation(_,_) :- fail.
answer(Y) :- reading(P), uses(P,O), observation(O,Y).
answer(parsing_abstention) :- reading(none).
any_supported :- observation(O,supported).
